- .claude/commands/escalation-judge.md:54-55 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The close branch describes branch-kind matching rules in prose without a formal matching algorithm or tests for the optional collision suffix and kind mappings.
  WHY: A judge could misidentify a branch kind and refuse to close a chain-owned PR or close an unrelated one, although the author and base-ref checks reduce the risk.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:74; scripts/security_audit.sh:1693-1700 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A successful audit can be treated as clean when earlier follow-up issues are closed and labelled `ai:merged`, even if the current audit still reports findings already listed on those issues.
  WHY: The audit script skips creating a new follow-up for a finding ID already present on an `ai:security` issue regardless of its state, allowing the project to proceed with an unresolved finding.
